sources.README.md:
# Acme CLI

Acme is a seamless, robust toolkit for modern teams — it just works.

It leverages a smart cache; builds are significantly faster.

As the author put it: "keep it simple — then ship".

# Guide

## Install

It's worth noting that the installer handles everything for you.

Run the setup script; it configures the project.

## Usage

The CLI boasts three modes · fast · safe · simple.

Delve into the config, ensuring every option is set.

I hope this helps!
